name: Yamanobe Miki
source:
Miki is a girl with a cheerful and energetic character. [url=https://vndb.org/c3658]Taichi[/url] jokes about her being his pupil in perversion. Her adaption coefficient is 40%, which Taichi remarks as being "right on the cut-off line."

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_Channel_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
